consequence.statement: A new metric, cilium_node_health_connectivity_latency_seconds, is available; the evidence describes nothing that breaks and no step the operator must take.

original.statement: Cilium 1.17.0 adds the metric cilium_node_health_connectivity_latency_seconds, listed under "Added Metrics" in the upgrade notes.

decision.reason: [ev-34619549fb8a] lists `cilium_node_health_connectivity_latency_seconds` under "1.17 Upgrade Notes › Added Metrics". The surrounding section ([ev-b598b51801ea] and the other items) is just a list of new metrics. Nothing in it says anything fails, is rejected, stops being honoured or must be migrated. A new metric is purely additive, so kind "none" (informational, low severity) is what the evidence supports.
